scope.question: Can the existing RCL typed module/link and typed bytecode path express and execute the physical command profile through the same native authority path while preserving roots?

positiveEvidence: The typed module graph compiles to rcl.type-module.semantic-ir.v0.29 with a deterministic root when app explicitly imports core.
A missing explicit import is rejected with RCL_MODULE_NOT_IMPORTED; the import boundary is now fail-closed and regression-tested.
The linked RCL compiler produces rcl.typed-compiler.semantic-map.v0.34 and a deterministic program root for core.SpatialCommand<Text>.
The typed program lowers to typed RBC object instructions and executes in the native VM with state-root verification and parity true.
The full RCL package regression completed with 612 passes, 1 skip and 0 failures; the targeted typed-module/linked-compiler/typed-bytecode/package set completed with 19/19 passes.
negativeEvidence: compileRclSource() calls compileSourceSelfHosted(source, { timeout }), compileRealityToBytecode(source) and verifyNativeParity(source, { nativeRuntime: { timeout } }); it does not forward typeModuleSources or bind a typed-module root.
The same typed source is rejected by the native authority compiler with RCLC_COMPILER_FAILURE at the record literal, before an authority execution receipt can be produced.
The current native authority compiler therefore cannot consume the P3 .rcltype graph, typed constructor lowering or typed package lock as one root-bound authority artifact.
No canonical world mutation, commit/promotion, device, production, external transport or K400 PASS is established by this audit.

commands: Direct Node probe: compileTypedModuleGraph → tryCompileReality → compileTypedRealityToBytecodeLayout → runNativeBytecode → compileRclSource

implementationFacts.fact: P3 typed module parsing, import/export graph validation, semantic IR and deterministic type-module root exist; explicit qualified cross-module imports are enforced.
tryCompileReality() accepts typeModuleSources/typeModuleReport, links the graph into typed bindings/semantic map and lowers a typed program root.
The typed program is compiled to RBC and executed by the native VM through the existing typed object layout path.
compileRclSource() still uses the self-host compiler plus untyped reference/parity calls and does not pass the typed-module graph into that authority path.
compileSourceSelfHosted() accepts source/compiler options for the native self-host compiler but has no typed-module graph/link input.

rclGap.task: Unify the existing P3 typed module, typed bytecode and native VM path with RNCS native authority-plan compilation without duplicating the RCL compiler or weakening authority boundaries.
rclGap.missingCapability: A versioned, root-bound typed link artifact consumed by the native authority compiler, including type-module root, package/lock root, source root, semantic/program root, bytecode root, native parity and explicit candidate-only authority metadata.
rclGap.workaround: Use the existing P3 JavaScript compiler plus typed RBC/native VM as a candidate execution path; keep the physical command profile and Kernel entity command batch as explicit control-plane/integration contracts.
rclGap.donor: Existing type-module-kernel, compiler.mjs typed resolver/semantic map, typed-bytecode-layout, typed heap/reference ABI, typed package lock and native C VM; no external donor promoted.
rclGap.generality: Reusable for physical command profiles, World Body IR, input/network commands, asset/behavior contracts and other typed world-facing artifacts.
rclGap.candidateAbsorption: Define and test a sealed typed-link receipt first; then add self-host/native compiler support and authority-plan root binding only after typed/reference/native parity, tamper, replay and candidate-only regressions pass.
